name: handprint
description: Handprint: a giving-pledge tracker with impact estimates. Donations from Actual Budget, income from a yearly config.

scripts.build:web: tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && esbuild src/web/main.ts --bundle --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=web-dist/app.js && cp web/index.html web-dist/index.html && mkdir -p web-dist/fonts && cp fonts/*.woff2 web-dist/fonts/
